'''2016 MPC Jeffrey Johns LS Combat Preparedness (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeffrey Johns]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard|Cor-L-tatooinewattosjunkyard.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Preparedness (V) Johns LS.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-match-play-championship/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-match-play-championship.html swccg.com snapshot], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013163128/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-match-play-championship.html Internet Archive]
